integrity: The likelihood was reconstructed from the published density and Section 3.1 formula. The proof uses exact differentiation, endpoint expansions, and strict concavity; no simulation or numerical plot is used to establish the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns complete positive samples and the single modified-Muth scale parameter only.
No uniqueness statement is made for maximum-product-spacing or minimum-distance estimators.
Strict concavity of reciprocal scale does not by itself certify unsafeguarded Newton convergence from every starting value.
An unindexed equivalent theorem under different likelihood terminology cannot be excluded.
title: Reciprocal scale makes the modified Muth likelihood globally strictly concave
